subject: English Language
name: Basic 5 English Language
description: The Basic 5 English Language curriculum focuses on enhancing oral language skills, reading comprehension, and grammar usage. It includes strands on songs, poetry, storytelling, dramatisations, conversation, and reading strategies.

strands.title: Oral Language (Listening and Speaking)
strands.description: Developing listening and speaking skills through songs, poetry, storytelling, dramatisation, and conversation.

subStrands.title: Songs
subStrands.description: Using songs to understand central messages and relate values to life.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of a variety of songs

indicators.description: Explain the central messages in songs

exemplars.description: Sing familiar patriotic songs and listen to selected songs.
Discuss the central message of the song using questions.
Invite individuals to explain the central message(s) of the song.

indicators.description: Relate values in songs to real life experiences

exemplars.description: Discuss the song and bring out the meaning.
Discuss values in the song (e.g., truthfulness, patience) and relate them to real life situations.
Share ideas with the class in the form of presentations.

subStrands.title: Poems
subStrands.description: Appreciating poems and relating their values to daily life.

contentStandards.description: Appreciate poems and other pieces of literary materials

indicators.description: Respond to poems by discussing their central messages and expressing own opinion

exemplars.description: Recite and act out a poem as learners listen and observe.
Recite lines of the poem with correct stress, clapping, and tapping out the rhythm.

indicators.description: Relate values in poems to day-to-day life

exemplars.description: Read the poem line by line and discuss the meaning.
Identify and discuss values in the poem (e.g., patience, love, patriotism) and relate them to real life situations.

indicators.description: Compose six-line poems

exemplars.description: Write out some lines of recited poems in groups.
Create or write meaningful lines similar to those in the poem and arrange them to compose a six-line poem.

subStrands.title: Story Telling
subStrands.description: Responding to stories and creating parallel narratives.

contentStandards.description: Respond to stories

indicators.description: Demonstrate understanding of lessons in stories by making relevant comments

exemplars.description: Identify the beginning, middle, and ending of a story.
Retell the story sequentially.
Discuss key details like characters, setting, and events.

indicators.description: Tell stories which are parallel to stories heard or read

exemplars.description: Identify areas in a story that can be changed or replaced to create a parallel story.
Write and present stories parallel to a familiar one.

subStrands.title: Dramatisation and Role Play
subStrands.description: Using drama to appreciate literary materials and key issues.

contentStandards.description: Appreciate pieces of literary materials through dramatisation

indicators.description: Use costume to dramatise or role-play parts/whole of stories

exemplars.description: Select a familiar story and assign roles.
Prepare costume and rehearse for performance.

contentStandards.description: Appreciate key issues in stories/sketches

indicators.description: Interpret moral values in plays/stories

exemplars.description: Identify moral values (e.g., truthfulness, perseverance) in a story/play.
Discuss how to apply those values to day-to-day living.

indicators.description: Develop sketches from stories read or heard

exemplars.description: Identify parts in stories and retell them.
Develop a sketch from the story in groups.

indicators.description: Analyse the actions of characters in sketches

exemplars.description: Identify and analyse characters and their actions in sketches.

subStrands.title: Conversation
subStrands.description: Engaging in conversation about oneself, family, people, customs, and social values.

contentStandards.description: Use culturally acceptable language for communication

indicators.description: Describe/talk about names of regions/places in the country as well as personalities in the community

exemplars.description: Discuss important personalities in the community.
Mention regions in the country and talk about important places in each region.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate positive listening and viewing attitudes and behaviour

indicators.description: Maintain appropriate posture and facial expression

exemplars.description: Engage in conversation maintaining appropriate posture and facial expressions.

indicators.description: Listen and view for the entire duration of a text, speech, presentation, video etc.

exemplars.description: Listen to an audio or video and describe what was seen and heard.

contentStandards.description: Use knowledge of language and communicative skills to participate in conversation

indicators.description: Engage in collaborative conversation on topics such as social issues, values and manners

exemplars.description: Initiate and contribute to conversations on topics like social values and manners.

indicators.description: Demonstrate turn taking in conversation on different topics

exemplars.description: Converse in pairs on different topics following agreed-upon rules like listening to others.

indicators.description: Respond to questions to give further clarification of an opinion

exemplars.description: Initiate a conversation and respond to questions to clarify opinions.

subStrands.title: Listening Comprehension
subStrands.description: Using skills and strategies to process meaning from texts.

contentStandards.description: Use appropriate skills and strategies to process meaning from texts

indicators.description: Employ the Think-Aloud strategy to convey meaning from level-appropriate texts

exemplars.description: Listen to a text and practice the Think-Aloud strategy to construct meaning.

indicators.description: Make connections with events in drama

exemplars.description: Identify the sequence of events in a drama and relate them to real life.

indicators.description: Relate to lessons in stories

exemplars.description: Identify characters, setting, and moral lessons in a story and relate them to life.

indicators.description: Use background knowledge to understand and build new knowledge while listening to drama

exemplars.description: Discuss and relate the plot of a drama to a familiar text.

indicators.description: Ask relevant questions to expand comprehension of details of texts

exemplars.description: Identify interesting stories and ask relevant questions to expand comprehension.

indicators.description: Distinguish between causes and effects of events in a story

exemplars.description: Identify events in a story and link them sequentially by identifying cause and effect.

indicators.description: Draw conclusions from main ideas, key details and specific examples from texts

exemplars.description: Identify specific examples to help bring out main ideas and key details to draw conclusions.

subStrands.title: Asking and Answering Questions
subStrands.description: Demonstrating understanding in asking and answering questions correctly.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding in asking and answering questions correctly

indicators.description: Use the various forms of 'do', 'be', 'have', appropriately in questions and responses

exemplars.description: Ask and answer questions using forms of 'do', 'be', and 'have'.

contentStandards.description: Identify and use question tags correctly in speech

indicators.description: Use positive tags, negative tags and auxiliaries in speech

exemplars.description: Practice using positive and negative tags in dialogues.

subStrands.title: Giving and Following Commands
subStrands.description: Using verbs in commands, instructions, requests, and directions appropriately.

contentStandards.description: Use verbs in commands, instructions, requests and directions appropriately in speech

indicators.description: Give and respond to commands, instructions; give and follow directions with clear landmarks

exemplars.description: Role-play giving and obeying commands/instructions and directions.

indicators.description: Make and respond to polite requests for help from familiar adults

exemplars.description: Demonstrate making polite requests using 'please'.

subStrands.title: Presentation
subStrands.description: Demonstrating knowledge of spoken grammar and register in presentations.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of spoken grammar and register

indicators.description: Demonstrate awareness of the features of spoken language

exemplars.description: Use contractions and ellipsis in speech.

indicators.description: Demonstrate awareness of the differences between spoken and written forms of language

exemplars.description: Discover differences between spoken (simple) and written (complex) forms.

indicators.description: Demonstrate awareness of how meaning is conveyed through appropriate pace, stress, tone

exemplars.description: Perform poems with appropriate intonation, stress, and rhythm.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate the ability to communicate with accurate pronunciation and appropriate intonation

indicators.description: Speak audibly and coherently, using the appropriate voice qualities

exemplars.description: Engage in dialogue or speech delivery maintaining good pace and tone.

indicators.description: Read aloud clearly, at a good pace and with expression

exemplars.description: Read speeches or texts aloud with appropriate expression and pace.

contentStandards.description: Plan and present information and ideas for a variety of purposes

indicators.description: Present information about personal experiences

exemplars.description: Plan and present a speech identifying purpose and audience.

indicators.description: Draw on prior knowledge to identify organisational structure of speech

exemplars.description: Discuss the structure of a model speech (heading, vocative address, introduction, body).

indicators.description: Gather and select facts and ideas from one or multiple print and non-print sources

exemplars.description: Generate ideas and details for speeches from various sources.

indicators.description: Support ideas and points of view by integrating selected visual and audio resources

exemplars.description: Select facts and ideas appropriate to the purpose, audience, context, and culture.

indicators.description: Use discourse markers to signpost stages in a presentation

exemplars.description: Identify and use discourse markers like 'For example', 'In summary'.

indicators.description: Elaborate on points using concrete examples

exemplars.description: Elaborate points with details, examples, and experiences.

indicators.description: Speak with confidence before different audiences and maintain appropriate posture

exemplars.description: Practice speaking before audiences using appropriate posture and eye contact.

strands.title: Reading
strands.description: Developing reading skills through phonics, word families, diphthongs, blends, vocabulary, and comprehension.

subStrands.title: Phonics
subStrands.description: Connecting sounds to letters and blending for reading.

contentStandards.description: Connect sounds to letters; and blend letters/syllables in order to read and write

indicators.description: Apply common phonic generalisations (e.g. hard and soft 'c' and 'g') when reading

exemplars.description: Introduce hard and soft forms of 'c' and 'g' with examples.

indicators.description: Read two syllable words with suffixes and 'r' controlled words

exemplars.description: Introduce 'r' controlled words (or, er, ar, ur) and read words containing them.

subStrands.title: Word Families: Minimal Pairs and Common Digraphs
subStrands.description: Identifying minimal pairs and common digraphs.

contentStandards.description: Identify minimal pairs and common digraphs

indicators.description: Use common minimal pairs to decode words

exemplars.description: Identify and read words containing minimal pairs.

indicators.description: Use words with digraphs to make meaningful sentences

exemplars.description: Identify words with digraphs and use them in sentences.

contentStandards.description: Identify and use diphthongs to decode

indicators.description: Use closing diphthongs to make meaningful sentences

exemplars.description: Identify words with diphthongs and use them in sentences.

subStrands.title: Blends and Consonant Clusters
subStrands.description: Identifying and using consonant blends and clusters.

contentStandards.description: Identify and use consonant blends and clusters in reading

indicators.description: Orally produce two-syllable words by blending sounds, including consonant blends

exemplars.description: Identify and list words having consonant blends and clusters.

indicators.description: Use the spelling-sound correspondences for common consonant digraphs

exemplars.description: Identify and spell words containing specific digraphs.

contentStandards.description: Understand word meanings and usages

indicators.description: Use level-appropriate content words and function words appropriately

exemplars.description: Identify and use content and function words in sentences.

indicators.description: Use terms: synonym, antonym, prefix, suffix, phrasal verb etc.

exemplars.description: Identify and use synonyms, antonyms, affixes, and phrasal verbs.

contentStandards.description: Build vocabulary

indicators.description: Develop a rich vocabulary stock through extensive reading

exemplars.description: Identify unfamiliar vocabulary in stories and find their meanings.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate a rich vocabulary that supports skills development

indicators.description: Deduce meaning of words from word class and relationships

exemplars.description: Use synonyms and antonyms to deduce meanings.

contentStandards.description: Use words appropriately for purpose, audience, context and culture

indicators.description: Recognise how words are formed through acronyms and clipping

exemplars.description: Identify and research acronyms and clipped words.

indicators.description: Recognise the playful use of words (jokes, riddles, puns)

exemplars.description: Demonstrate and use playful language like jokes and riddles.

indicators.description: Use words suitable for purpose, audience, context and culture

exemplars.description: Identify key elements in writing like purpose and audience.

contentStandards.description: Process and comprehend level appropriate texts

indicators.description: Construct meaning from text read

exemplars.description: Use strategies like prior knowledge and prediction to make meaning.

indicators.description: Note and recall main ideas in a sequence

exemplars.description: Use SQ3R strategy to present facts sequentially.

indicators.description: Scan texts for details

exemplars.description: Skim and scan texts for details and write down ideas.

indicators.description: Read level-appropriate texts silently and closely for comprehension

exemplars.description: Read texts using the Directed Reading Activity (DRA) strategy.

contentStandards.description: Apply critical reading, implied meaning, higher order thinking, judgment and evaluation

indicators.description: Respond to a text with simple judgment and personal interpretations

exemplars.description: Create mental images and respond to texts with judgment.

indicators.description: Relate two or more ideas in a text

exemplars.description: Make personal connections and relate ideas within or across texts.

indicators.description: Demonstrate awareness of the structure of texts

exemplars.description: Identify introduction, body, and conclusion of a text.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate an understanding of the use of words and phrases as used in a text

indicators.description: Use knowledge of prefixes and suffixes to read and interpret unfamiliar words

exemplars.description: Identify affixes in words and use them in sentences.

contentStandards.description: Construct meaning from texts read

indicators.description: Infer meaning from level-appropriate texts

exemplars.description: Read silently and stop to think about meaning.

indicators.description: Find the meaning of words as used in context

exemplars.description: Find meaning of words in context using Think-Pair-Share.

indicators.description: Answer questions based on the passage read

exemplars.description: Pose and answer questions to clarify meaning.

subStrands.title: Fluency
subStrands.description: Reading texts fluently to enhance comprehension.

contentStandards.description: Read fluently to enhance comprehension

indicators.description: Read grade-level texts with good speed and accuracy

exemplars.description: Read texts with purpose and understanding using strategies like KWL.

indicators.description: Use context to confirm or self-correction strategies

exemplars.description: Read texts paying attention to punctuation and use correction strategies.

subStrands.title: Summarising
subStrands.description: Summarising texts orally and in writing.

contentStandards.description: Read and summarise passages read

indicators.description: Summarise level-appropriate texts/passages orally

exemplars.description: Identify important ideas and restate them in own words.

indicators.description: Write a short summary of a level-appropriate text/passage read

exemplars.description: Write a summary of a text noting main ideas.
